items.content_html: YaLoSé ("I already know it") is a lightweight, offline-first Flashcards Word Memory PWA designed to help users master Spanish vocabulary. The app focuses on high-frequency words, utilizing data from the Real Academia Española (RAE) and community translations via Crowdin. It is architected to be hosted 100% free on GitHub Pages.
